window.note: t = seconds from the H1 merger (template peak)

series.white-H1: whitened, band-passed 35–350 Hz, in units of the noise σ
series.white-L1: whitened, band-passed 35–350 Hz, in units of the noise σ (not shifted, not inverted)
series.fit-white-H1: best-fit template whitened and band-passed like white-H1
series.fit-white-L1: best-fit template whitened and band-passed like white-L1
series.bandpass-H1: strain ×1e21, band-passed 35–350 Hz and notched at the instrumental lines (PRL fig. 1 style)
series.bandpass-L1: strain ×1e21, band-passed and notched like bandpass-H1
series.snr-net: network SNR, sqrt(H1² + L1²) with L1 shifted by dtL1
series.template-strain-H1: best-fit template at Hanford, physical strain ×1e21
series.template-freq: its gravitational-wave frequency, Hz (orbital frequency = half)
series.template-phase: its gravitational-wave phase, rad, 0 at the merger (orbital phase = half)

offset.note: dtL1 = L1 merger time − H1 merger time (s); negative: Livingston first. sign −1: L1 inverted.

chirp-H1.label: Hanford (H1), whitened and band-passed 35–350 Hz, real time and pitch

chirp-L1.label: Livingston (L1), whitened and band-passed 35–350 Hz, real time and pitch

chirp-H1-x4.label: Hanford (H1), whitened; pitch raised ×4 (two octaves) for small speakers, same duration

chirp-template.label: Best-fit template (SEOBNRv2), whitened like the H1 data: no noise

chirp-template-x4.label: Best-fit template, pitch raised ×4 (two octaves), same duration
